summary.headline: Senores FY26 consolidated revenue rose 62% to about INR664 crore and PAT more than doubled to INR122 crore; FY27 guided to 30-40% revenue growth.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 consolidated income rose 66% YoY to about INR190 crore, with EBITDA of INR62 crore (32.7% margin, up about 1,151 bps) and PAT after minority interest of about INR32 crore (up 78%). Regulated markets drove the quarter at INR118 crore (up 83%), while emerging markets grew 26% and India branded generics roughly doubled to about INR9 crore. Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 30-40% and PAT growth of 50-60%, with blended EBITDA margin held at 29-31%. The Apnar Pharma acquisition (75% stake, 25% due by year-end) weighed on working capital and margin in Q4, with commercial shipments only starting in April 2026.

segments.name: Regulated markets (US and others)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR427 crore, up 75%; Q4 INR118 crore, up 83%, driven by portfolio expansion. Sourced/spot business is 10-12% of total revenue and is not expected to grow.

segments.name: Emerging markets
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR145 crore, up 20%. Q4 was the highest-ever quarter with EBITDA margin of 18-19%; management expects this margin to hold, and the segment is now cash-flow positive. FY27 revenue projection is about INR180 crore.

segments.name: India branded generics
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue about INR40 crore, roughly 5x FY25. FY26 budget is INR60-70 crore; about 120-130 MRs in field, with a long-run plateau of about 200 MRs.

segments.name: CDMO-CMO and own products
segments.commentary: Management says own products are about 50-53% and CDMO-CMO about 47-48% of revenue. Apnar facility is expected to contribute INR80-100 crore in FY27 and INR180-200 crore in 2-3 years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at about 30-40%, with PAT growth of about 50-60%; management called 30-35% the minimum achievable and will review after one or two quarters.
Blended EBITDA margin guided at 29-31% for FY27; ex-other-income, Q4 FY26 margin of 26.5% could be about 28-28.5%.
Apnar Pharma FY27 revenue budgeted at INR80-100 crore; Q1 FY27 revenue expected at INR10-20 crore; INR180-200 crore in 2-3 years.
Emerging markets FY27 revenue projected at about INR180 crore, with EBITDA margin of about 18-21%.
Amerisyn JV FY27 revenue budgeted at INR50-80 crore (management cited INR80-100 crore, then conservative INR50-70 crore), at EBITDA margin around 40%.
Capex FY27 about INR200 crore, including about INR100 crore for injectables and the balance for other plants and maintenance; management expects FCF generation in FY27.
Long-term aspiration of INR2,500-3,000 crore (up to INR4,000 crore) US revenue in 3-4 years across India and US facilities; ANDA rollout of 90-95% of the 51 approved ANDAs within 6-8 quarters.
capex_capacity: FY26 capex about INR230 crore, including about INR65 crore for an ANDA acquisition.
FY27 capex expected at about INR200 crore, including about INR100 crore for injectables; about INR100 crore IPO proceeds earmarked for sterile manufacturing, to be started within this year.
Apnar Pharma (Baroda, USFDA-approved, also approved by UK MHRA and Health Canada): 75% acquired in Q4 FY26, remaining 25% by end of year; multiple pre-built clean rooms and expansion-ready.
Atlanta OSD facility: three lines commercialised; fourth line deferred due to Apnar acquisition; decision on fourth line or Apnar expansion expected within two quarters.
Emerging markets PIC/S approval for the facility expected around June-July 2026; more than 4,000 products under registration in emerging markets.
demand_pricing: Approved ANDAs rose from 22 (March 2025) to 51 (March 2026), covering more than 150 strengths; 20-21 launched, 30 to be launched over next few quarters; about 27 further molecules (60+ strengths) in development.
Management estimates the total accessible market for currently approved products plus pipeline at close to $1 billion.
Emerging market realisation per unit rose from about INR1.20 to about INR1.90 over 1-1.5 years (about 60-70%), with a shift to niche molecules.
Amerisyn JV (entered April 2026) targets US federal, VA and military procurement and FSS tenders; management says margins are not thin.
Management says branded generics do not need a large MR expansion to scale.

qa_highlights.question: Why did net working capital days rise from 114 to 187, and what is steady state?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said the jump is due to Apnar being consolidated with no sales yet; excluding Apnar, the cycle is about 104 days. Apnar is expected to align with group cycle from FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What is other financial assets of INR172 crore (previously unbilled revenue)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is profit share on cost-plus B2B supplies, booked as income and parked as a financial asset until realised, typically 1-6 months. Balance should plateau then fall as launches mature. Not warranty or royalty.

qa_highlights.question: Why is FY27 guidance conservative given 60% growth history?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited external uncertainty (shipping, US inflation) and said 30-35% is the minimum achievable; guidance to be revisited after one or two quarters.

qa_highlights.question: Emerging market margin improvement: forex versus operations?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said margin gain mainly came from product mix; forex contributed about INR3 crore of realised gains in the year.

qa_highlights.question: Tax rate jump from about 17% in FY25 to about 23.6% in FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed the rise to the Apnar tax provision, US tax at 20-21%, and India at 26%, and to FY25 benefit from US carry-forward losses. Long-term rate guided at about 23%.

risks_watch: Apnar revenue ramp: only about INR2.5-3 crore in the last three months; management guides INR10-20 crore in Q1 FY27 and INR80-100 crore for FY27.
Working capital and receivables: other financial assets (INR172 crore) and working capital days (187) need to normalise.
Guidance credibility: management said FY27 revenue guidance is conservative; a revision is possible after one or two quarters.
Execution on 30 pending ANDA launches over 6-8 quarters and the INR2,500-3,000 crore US target, which depends on launch timing.
Macro factors (shipping, US inflation, geopolitics) flagged by management as affecting margins.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the growth outlook and the US strategy, but deliberately conservative on FY27 guidance, citing external uncertainty. Management was evasive on the other financial assets line, deferring the explanation to an offline session, and on the margin definition (EBITDA with or without other income).
